name: Bases Task Rows
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Reads ISO date links in Tasks and Dataview fields.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Due dates written as date links in Tasks and Dataview fields are now read.
Dates that do not exist on the calendar are ignored.
tip: Select the calendar button on a row to move the task's due date to today, with Pro.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases Task Rows is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with Bases. Bases is still new, and your setups teach me a lot.

related.name: Task Date Links
related.blurb: Adds a real daily note link to a task when you complete it, so backlinks show what you finished each day.
